sourceBasis.step: Lemma 4 fixes the number of colors q. In its construction for a Chained Positive CNF-SAT instance of length S and parameter k, choose q of order √(log S). Encoding the choices in base q uses at most 1+log_q S digits per group. The connector branches can be processed separately, so Claim 12 bounds the width by 2k(1+log_q S)+3. Adding a clique of q colors enforces the lists at an additional width cost of at most q. The graph still has polynomial size, and t log₂(t+2) is at most a computable function of k times 1+log₂ S. Composing with the Clique reduction supplied by Theorem 9, the effective cutoff would turn a solver within the displayed time into an FPT algorithm for Clique.
